body: IPO Jun 2017 at ₹149 (≈₹74.5 after the 2024 1:1 bonus). ₹94 (Aug 2019) → ATH ₹1,943 (Dec 2024) ≈21x; P/E 16.7 → 76 (4.6x) × implied EPS ~4.5x, about 50% rerating. ₹1,423 on 19 Nov 2026 (−27%). Drawdowns: −53% (2017–19), −44% (Jan 2022–Mar 2023), −45% (Dec 2024–Mar 2025). Early signal: depository account counts are public. CDSL went from 1 cr accounts (Sep 2015) to 2 cr (Jan 2020), 3 cr (Jan 2021) and 4 cr (Jul 2021); FY21 added in about four months what FY17 or FY18 added in a year. Q4 FY21 profit ₹51.7 cr vs ₹28.6 cr. In Mar 2020 the stock sat at P/E ~20 while the account curve was going vertical (COVID-era retail inflows, IPO boom). Ended/stalled: account additions and IPO/KYC revenue slowed in 2022, and after the SEBI F&O curbs (late 2024) trading-linked revenue cooled; EPS FY25 ₹25.2 → FY26 ₹21.8. Lesson: a free monthly alt-data series gave a 6–12 month lead, but at 60–76x the multiple already discounted the boom; when the series flattened, half the gain went.

data.lesson: alt-data lead, but price the boom cyclically
data.note: Prices: screener.in weekly closes, split/bonus-adjusted. P/E = trailing (TTM); implied EPS x = price multiple / P/E multiple.

title: CDSL 2019–2024: demat-account boom in public monthly data, ~21x
